capabilities: Assign custom colors to tags via regex rules
Manage color rules in a settings panel
Prioritize rules by order (first match wins)
Reset rules to a default configuration
extras: Not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff; requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or newer; supports desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian renders all tags in the same style, so users cannot visually distinguish tags by name, prefix, or pattern.
summary: Regex-based tag colorizer that assigns custom text colors and derived backgrounds to tags matching user-defined rules.
